svg.text: Every structure, every section & segment, and the exact tool + command to read each byte — 64-bit System V ABI (x86-64).
refs: elf(5) · System V gABI + x86-64 psABI · /usr/include/elf.h · kernel fs/binfmt_elf.c · musl ldso/dynlink.c
LINKING VIEW ▸ sections (what as / ld build)
no section · RW (no X) ⇒ non-exec stack (NX)
in NO segment — on disk only, never mapped at runtime.
file prog · xxd -l16 prog · magic is 7f 45 4c 46
the array in .dynamic; ends with DT_NULL
STRTAB RELA REL HASH GNU_HASH DYN-
W write · A alloc · X exec
M merge · S strings · T tls · I info-link
then: name + desc, each padded to 4 bytes
shared library to load (one per dep)
the DIE tree: types, vars, functions
read: objdump -g · readelf --debug-dump=… · llvm-dwarfdump · pahole · gdb
the signal that caused the dump
produce: ulimit -c unlimited · gcore <pid> · kernel elf_core_dump()
read: gdb ./prog core · readelf -n core · eu-readelf -n
S=symbol value · A=addend · P=place (r_offset) · B=load base
L=PLT entry · G=GOT-relative offset · GOT=.got address
Lazy binding: PLT → GOT → resolver (first call)
1st time GOT points back after the jmp
push relocation index, go to PLT[0]
next calls jump straight to puts (bound)
read: readelf -lW (TLS row) · readelf -r | grep TPOFF
how to detect in the ELF
dynamic tags: readelf -d · quick check: checksec --file=./p
mmap each segment with p_flags perms
build stack: argc argv envp AUXV
jump to ld.so entry (or _start if static)
AT_PHDR AT_PHNUM AT_ENTRY AT_BASE AT_PAGESZ AT_RANDOM
LD_PRELOAD interposes before all of it · man ld.so
what to know / how to read
ET_DYN mapped by kernel; base in AT_SYSINFO_EHDR
